dataset.name: COCO-128
dataset.annotation_format: YOLO txt / COCO JSON ground-truth boxes
dataset.benchmark_classification: Diagnostic sanity check (not independent field validation)

metrics_recorded: F1-Score (harmonic mean of macro P & R)
dataset_classification: The adopted COCO-128 evaluation is a lightweight diagnostic benchmark. It does not represent the full diversity of real-world obstacles or rare navigational hazards encountered by a body-worn assistive device. No claims of navigation safety, real-world obstacle-avoidance reliability, or physical sensor fusion performance are made or implied based on these software benchmark results.
